001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi;
002
003import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable;
004import org.slf4j.Logger;
005import org.slf4j.Marker;
006import org.slf4j.event.Level;
007import org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder;
008import org.slf4j.spi.NOPLoggingEventBuilder;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi.LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareEventBuilder;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi.LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareLogger;
013
014/**
015 * A base class for {@link LoggerDecoratorService} implementations that need to filter or
016 * enrich log calls without depending on {@link org.slf4j.helpers.AbstractLogger}'s
017 * internal dispatch, whose stack depth to the real caller is an unversioned SLF4J
018 * implementation detail rather than something Rainbow Gum controls or tests.
019 * <p>
020 * Every convenience method ({@code info(String)}, {@code error(String,Object)}, marker
021 * variants, ...) funnels through exactly one internal dispatch method before
022 * {@link #isEnabled(Level, Marker)} and {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}
023 * run, so the frame count from any convenience method to caller-info capture is fixed and
024 * verified once by this class's own tests. Subclasses never need to reason about stack
025 * depth. Non-marker convenience methods pass a {@code null} marker to both hooks.
026 * <p>
027 * The fluent {@code atInfo()} style API ({@link #makeLoggingEventBuilder(Level)}) is a
028 * transparent pass-through to {@link #delegate()} and does <strong>not</strong> invoke
029 * either hook, since there is no populated event (or marker) to filter or decorate yet at
030 * that point.
031 *
032 * @see LoggerDecoratorService LoggerDecoratorService for a full example and how to
033 * register a decorator.
034 */
035public abstract class AbstractFilteringLogger implements Logger, DepthAwareLogger {
036
037        /*
038         * Frames between builder.log() and the real caller: this class's own normalizedLog(),
039         * plus the public convenience method (info(), error(), marker variant, ...) that
040         * called it. Both are declared in this class - never delegate one convenience method
041         * to another, or that adds an untracked frame. Fixed and verified by
042         * AbstractFilteringLoggerTest.
043         */
044        private static final int DEPTH = 2;
045
046        private final DepthAwareLogger delegate;
047
048        /**
049         * Creates a filtering logger wrapping the given delegate.
050         * @param delegate logger to wrap.
051         */
052        protected AbstractFilteringLogger(DepthAwareLogger delegate) {
053                this.delegate = delegate;
054        }
055
056        /**
057         * The wrapped logger that ultimately receives log calls.
058         * @return delegate.
059         */
060        public DepthAwareLogger delegate() {
061                return delegate;
062        }
063
064        /**
065         * Cheap pre-check run before any {@link LoggingEventBuilder} is built, analogous to
066         * {@code isInfoEnabled()}/{@code isInfoEnabled(Marker)}. Override to filter out
067         * events (sampling, per-logger overrides, per-marker rules, ...) without paying for
068         * message formatting or key-value collection.
069         * @param level level of the event.
070         * @param marker marker passed to the convenience method that was called, or null if a
071         * non-marker overload was used.
072         * @return true if enabled and {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)} may run.
073         */
074        protected boolean isEnabled(Level level, @Nullable Marker marker) {
075                return true;
076        }
077
078        /**
079         * Called with the already-populated builder (message, arguments and cause already set
080         * from whatever convenience method arity the caller used). Override to add key
081         * values, rewrite the message, etc. The marker is passed here rather than added to
082         * the builder automatically, since there is no default meaningful behavior for it
083         * (e.g. a decorator can call
084         * {@code builder.addKeyValue("_marker", marker.toString())} if it wants markers
085         * surfaced at all).
086         * <p>
087         * <strong>Do not call {@code builder.log()} directly from this method</strong> -
088         * doing so adds an untracked stack frame and caller info will point at the wrong
089         * line. To mutate and let it log normally, just mutate {@code builder} and return
090         * {@code true}. To log it yourself (e.g. conditionally, or more than once) use
091         * {@link #log(LoggingEventBuilder)} instead of {@code builder.log()}, and return
092         * {@code false} so this class does not log it again. To drop the event entirely, do
093         * neither and return {@code false}.
094         * @param builder builder about to be logged.
095         * @param marker marker passed to the convenience method that was called, or null if a
096         * non-marker overload was used.
097         * @return true to have this class call {@code builder.log()} after this method
098         * returns; false if you called {@link #log(LoggingEventBuilder)} yourself or want to
099         * drop the event.
100         */
101        protected boolean decorate(LoggingEventBuilder builder, @Nullable Marker marker) {
102                return true;
103        }
104
105        /**
106         * Logs a builder obtained from a {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}
107         * override that returned {@code false}, with caller-info depth adjusted for the extra
108         * frames both {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)} and this method itself
109         * add. Never call {@code builder.log()} directly from
110         * {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}.
111         * @param builder builder to log, previously handed to
112         * {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}.
113         */
114        protected final void log(LoggingEventBuilder builder) {
115                /*
116                 * +2, not +1: the call chain here is normalizedLog() -> decorate() -> log() ->
117                 * builder.log(), i.e. both decorate() and this method are extra frames beyond the
118                 * normalizedLog()+convenience-method pair DEPTH already accounts for.
119                 */
120                DepthAwareEventBuilder.setDepth(builder, DEPTH + 2);
121                builder.log();
122        }
123
124        @Override
125        public String getName() {
126                return delegate.getName();
127        }
128
129        /**
130         * A no-op: unlike {@link org.slf4j.helpers.AbstractLogger}-based decorators, this
131         * class's caller-info depth is a fixed internal constant rather than derived from the
132         * wrap-count
133         * {@link LoggerDecoratorService#decorate(RainbowGum, DepthAwareLogger, int)} passes
134         * in, so there is nothing to recreate.
135         * @param depth ignored.
136         * @return this.
137         */
138        @Override
139        public Logger withDepth(int depth) {
140                return this;
141        }
142
143        @Override
144        public boolean isEnabledForLevel(Level level) {
145                return isEnabledForLevel(level, null);
146        }
147
148        private boolean isEnabledForLevel(Level level, @Nullable Marker marker) {
149                return delegate.isEnabledForLevel(level) && isEnabled(level, marker);
150        }
151
152        @Override
153        public LoggingEventBuilder makeLoggingEventBuilder(Level level) {
154                if (!delegate.isEnabledForLevel(level)) {
155                        return NOPLoggingEventBuilder.singleton();
156                }
157                return delegate.makeLoggingEventBuilder(level);
158        }
159
160        private void normalizedLog(Level level, @Nullable Marker marker, @Nullable String message, @Nullable Object arg1,
161                        @Nullable Object arg2, @Nullable Object @Nullable [] argArray, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
162                if (!isEnabledForLevel(level, marker)) {
163                        return;
164                }
165                var builder = DepthAwareEventBuilder.setDepth(delegate.makeLoggingEventBuilder(level), DEPTH);
166                if (message != null) {
167                        builder.setMessage(message);
168                }
169                if (arg1 != null) {
170                        builder.addArgument(arg1);
171                }
172                if (arg2 != null) {
173                        builder.addArgument(arg2);
174                }
175                if (argArray != null) {
176                        for (var a : argArray) {
177                                builder.addArgument(a);
178                        }
179                }
180                if (throwable != null) {
181                        builder.setCause(throwable);
182                }
183                if (decorate(builder, marker)) {
184                        builder.log();
185                }
186        }
187
